attack_plan.narrative: Recent reports suggest that Putin’s sudden disappearance has triggered a wave of paranoia among Russian officials and opposition figures. Some are speculating that he may have been removed through a 'palace coup,' leading to a power vacuum and subsequent chaos. Reports indicate that Putin was last seen in the Stockholm Archipelago, suggesting a possible escape route or a covert relocation. This has fueled suspicions that he may have orchestrated his own disappearance as part of a broader strategy to consolidate power. High-ranking officials, including former intelligence officers and military leaders, have been discussing the possibility of a 'palace coup.' These individuals have a history of making unsubstantiated claims about Putin’s health and well-being, adding to the growing sense of uncertainty. The recent outpouring of paranoia and speculation about Putin’s whereabouts suggests a weakening of his support base, raising the possibility of a palace coup to seize control.
